cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims decision power and A3 delays questions, but A5 is only an ordinary defensive probe about a witness.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 suspicion and lockup question inform A3 scope inquiry; B4 eyewitness information directly informs A5.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks about A responsibility and B4 answers the scope question, giving B a credible information-sharing role.

heightening.evidence: B4 narrows suspicion to A, and A5 tests the evidence boundary; status does not heighten alongside it.

specificity.evidence: A1 missing keys and B2 drain establish the inquiry, with B4 introducing a witness intelligibly.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 generic decision sentence adds bulk without specifying what is being approved; A5 is otherwise playable.

coach2.inferred: A3 indicates defensiveness, not proof that A lost the keys.
coach2.missing: No essential fact is missing to understand the information probe.
coach2.firstDefect: A5 does not enact the approval relationship asserted in A1 and A3.

A1-B2.evidence: A1 asks manager information; B2 offers drain suspicion and asks about lockup.

B2-A3.evidence: B2 asks about responsibility; A3 instead asks whether the manager targets A.

A3-B4.evidence: A3 asks who is questioned; B4 says just A and supplies a witness.

B4-A5.evidence: B4 location evidence leads A5 to distinguish action from presence.
